_comment: Bundled Truth or Dare prompts. Ids are stored in user settings to disable entries: never reuse or renumber an id; append new ones.

truths.text: What is a habit of yours you would never admit to in public?
What is the silliest thing you have ever been afraid of?
What is the worst gift you have ever received, and what did you say when you opened it?
Who here would you want beside you in a crisis, and why?
What is something you pretend to understand but don't?
What is the most childish thing you still do?
If you could swap lives with {other} for a day, what would you do first?
What was the last lie you told?
What is your most irrational pet peeve?
What talent do you secretly wish you had?
What is the strangest dream you remember?
Who here would survive longest in the wilderness, and who would go first?
What food do you claim to like but actually can't stand?
What is the most trouble you ever got into as a child?
What is one thing you would change about yourself if you could?
Who here would you most want to be stuck somewhere alone with for a night?
What is the most embarrassing thing you have done to impress someone?
What was your honest first impression of {other}?
What is the most awkward first meeting you have ever had with someone you liked?
Have you ever had a crush on someone you shouldn't have? Who?
What is something you have never told anyone here?
What is the pettiest revenge you have ever taken?
Who here do you think has a secret crush, and on whom?
What is the worst thing you have done and gotten away with?
What is the most jealous you have ever been?
Rank everyone here by how good a kisser you think they are.
What is a rumor about you that is actually true?
What is the boldest line anyone has ever used on you, or you on them?
Who here would you trust least with a secret?
What is the most embarrassing thing you own?
What is the biggest secret you are keeping right now?
What is the worst thing you have ever said about someone here behind their back?
What have you done that you would never want your family to find out about?
If you had to court someone here, who would it be and why?
What is the most reckless thing you have ever done?
What is one thing about {other} that annoys you more than it should?
What is the biggest lie you have ever told someone here?
What is your deepest regret?
Who here would you least want to be left alone with, and why?
What is something you are genuinely ashamed of?
What do you really think of {other}? Be completely honest.
Have you ever betrayed a friend's trust? What happened?
What is a desire you have never said out loud?
What is the most scandalous thing you have witnessed and kept quiet about?

dares.text: Do your best impression of {other} until someone guesses who it is.
Speak only in rhymes until your next turn.
Let {other} give you a nickname that everyone must use for the rest of the game.
Tell a joke. If nobody laughs, tell another.
Sing the chorus of a song {other} chooses.
Talk in an over-the-top accent until your next turn.
Give everyone here a sincere compliment.
Act out a famous scene from a story without words until someone guesses it.
Do ten jumping jacks while reciting the alphabet.
Balance something on your head until your next turn.
Narrate everything you do in the third person until your next turn.
Let {other} style your hair however they like.
Make up a short poem about {other} on the spot.
Perform your most dramatic slow-motion fall.
Hold a staring contest with {other}. Whoever blinks first does a forfeit of the winner's choosing.
Serenade {other} with a love song of your choice.
Give {other} your most convincing romantic line.
Swap an item of clothing with {other} until your next turn.
Let {other} draw something on your arm or face.
Confess something embarrassing to the whole group in a dramatic voice.
Dance with {other} until your next turn.
Describe {other} as if you were writing a glowing personal ad for them.
Do your best runway walk across the room.
Let the group pick a word you must work into everything you say until your next turn.
Act out how you would propose to {other}.
Give {other} a shoulder rub for one minute.
Imitate how you think {other} flirts.
Let {other} choose a ridiculous pose you must hold for a full minute.
Tell {other} three things you genuinely admire about them while looking them in the eye.
Let {other} ask you any question; you must answer truthfully.
Kiss {other} on the cheek.
Let the group invent a dare for you on the spot.
Sit on {other}'s lap until your next turn.
Whisper something in {other}'s ear that makes them blush.
Slow dance with {other}, with no music.
Trade seats with {other} and imitate them until your next turn.
Eat or drink something the group mixes together for you.
Hold hands with {other} until your next turn.
Go somewhere you will be overheard and loudly declare your admiration for {other}.
Make a dramatic declaration of love to an object in the room.
Let {other} tickle you for thirty seconds without laughing.
Reveal the most embarrassing nickname you have ever had and let everyone use it until your next turn.
Describe your ideal evening with {other}, in detail.
